description.pt: Explore as ruas e o relevo de Barcelos num mapa 3D interativo. Pré-visualização: pontos de interesse e percursos ainda não disponíveis.
description.en: Explore the streets and terrain of Barcelos in an interactive 3D map. Early preview: landmarks and routes are not yet available.
description.ru: Исследуйте улицы и рельеф Барселуша на интерактивной 3D-карте. Предварительная версия: достопримечательности и маршруты пока недоступны.

domain_note: Barcelos is Portugal's rooster town and a UNESCO Creative City of Crafts and Folk Art; the domain waits for the deploy.

terrain.datum_note: y=0 at the centre DEM height

transit.todo: find a GTFS feed on dados.gov.pt / NAP; else schedule line from the station and the Via Verde bus

landmark_candidates.why: Gothic bridge over the Cávado, built 1325–1328 by Count Pedro Afonso

landmark_candidates.name_pt: Templo do Senhor Bom Jesus da Cruz
landmark_candidates.why: Baroque temple (1705–1710) on the Campo da Feira, from the Miracle of the Holy Cross

landmark_candidates.name_pt: Igreja Matriz de Barcelos (Santa Maria Maior)
landmark_candidates.why: Collegiate church enlarged in the 14th–15th c.; gilded interior
15th-c. palace of the Dukes of Braganza, now the archaeological museum

landmark_candidates.name_pt: Torre de Menagem / Torre da Porta Nova
landmark_candidates.why: Medieval keep, last standing piece of the 15th-c. town walls
Stone cross of the Rooster of Barcelos legend, the town's symbol
Pottery museum in the historic centre; 'figurado' folk ceramics

landmark_candidates.name_pt: Paços do Concelho e Largo do Município
landmark_candidates.why: City hall and the main civic square of the old town

landmark_candidates.name_pt: Igreja da Ordem Terceira de São Francisco
landmark_candidates.why: 18th-c. church of the Third Order of St Francis
18th-c. monastery linked to the Terço devotion
Rare three-storey 15th-c. manor recorded in medieval Barcelos
Municipal theatre named after the playwright born near Barcelos
Home of Gil Vicente FC, the town's Primeira Liga club
Large riverside city park by the Cávado
Formal garden beside the historic centre
Covered market, centre of a fair town famous since the Middle Ages
Old parish church on the east bank of the historic centre
Parish church of Barcelinhos across the bridge

landmark_candidates.name_pt: Santuário de Nossa Senhora da Franqueira
landmark_candidates.why: Hill sanctuary above the Cávado with a long pilgrimage tradition

notes: Start city for barcelos-3d, forked from braga-3d (engine copy, fresh history). Bboxes are a first estimate around the historic centre and the Cávado; pin tiles/terrain.lattice here later once the pipeline has run. Landmark candidates carry provisional coordinates; the landmark agents replace them with real OSM outlines and sourced dimensions in data/new/.
